claim_scope: development-only bounded memorisation of the Stage-0A pre-cycle-to-peak operator

map.input: (d_s00 on nodes, [H,alpha_bar,q_prev,f]_s00 on native GP, complete prescribed path, frozen mesh/material/boundary data)
map.output: (d_s04 on nodes, [H,alpha_bar,q_prev,f]_s04 on native GP, u_s04 on nodes)

interface.model_increment_buffers: construct directly from JSON decimal values as torch.float64; no float32 intermediate
interface.derived_channel: f is derived from alpha_bar and has no independent raw head

hard_constraint_contract.check_time: after projected forward output, before each loss/metric use, at initial/final evaluation and every training update

peak_boundary_lifting.predicate: abs(u_peak-u_affine) <= atol + rtol*abs(u_affine) on prescribed boundary DOFs

hard_constraint_contract.counting_rule: count only projected-output violations of these predicates; raw proposal clipping/saturation is logged separately and is not a hard-constraint violation
hard_constraint_contract.input_failure: any prestate qualification failure stops before model construction; teacher f is never rewritten

optimisation.gradient_merge: positive-norm median equalisation, fixed cyclic projection against immutable balanced references, mean, one global clip
optimisation.zero_gradient_handling: replace that objective direction with zero and log it
optimisation.optimizer_step_order: zero_grad; three separate autograd gradients; merge; assign once; finite check; one clip already in merge; optimizer.step

gradient_vector_contract.parameter_order: single frozen model.named_parameters() order recorded in config_resolved.json
gradient_vector_contract.per_objective_vector: flatten every parameter block in frozen order
gradient_vector_contract.unconnected_parameter: insert an exact zero block of the parameter shape and log the parameter name per objective
gradient_vector_contract.missing_record: absence of a block or parameter-name/order mismatch is a stop; it is not a zero gradient
gradient_vector_contract.whole_objective_zero: full-vector norm <= gradient_epsilon; replace direction with zero and log
gradient_vector_contract.positive_norm_reference: torch.median of positive full-vector norms; lower median when the count is even
gradient_vector_contract.projection_denominator: skip immutable reference only when its squared norm <= gradient_epsilon**2
gradient_vector_contract.projection_order: fixed cyclic order against immutable balanced references
gradient_vector_contract.average: arithmetic mean of all three projected directions, including zero directions
gradient_vector_contract.clip: one global L2 clip after averaging

evaluation.initial: after deterministic construction and before any optimiser state mutation
evaluation.final: evaluation mode after exactly 1000 successful updates
evaluation.growth_clause: selected growth-group mean weighted damage-increment MAE < persistence baseline mean(g_k)
evaluation.validity_clause: finite outputs and gradients; zero projected-output hard-constraint violations under model.hard_constraint_contract

failure_stops: nonfinite input, output, loss or gradient
optimizer update count differs from receipt
write path outside the fresh run roots
prohibited: random cycle split or held-out claim
more than one seed or more than 1000 updates
accuracy, generalisation, FEM-truth, teacher-validity or PINO-benefit claim from this run
next_gate: implement packet exporter and trainer, test locally without scientific training, then exact-commit independent Code Ready review
resolution_order: implement exporter and trainer and run synthetic/local no-training tests
freeze candidate trainer exact commit before Code Ready submission
Code Ready approves that same exact commit
reviewed exporter creates packet and binds exact bytes/hash/data lock
read-only Taobo GPU/environment preflight locks GPU ID and environment
equilibrium normaliser is computed with the same reviewed physics implementation and frozen before model construction; nonfinite/nonpositive stops
write resolved config and obtain final execution gate before any optimiser step
